description: The charge-word definition: words in an issue's title or body that name a metered or renewing charge, which admission refuses until the owner decides it. rule-admit.sh reads it, and so does intake admission in the marketplace repository (.github/scripts/intake-triage/admit.mjs). Each value is a regular expression valid in both jq (Oniguruma) and JavaScript, matched case-insensitively. `code` is removed from the text first (closed fenced blocks and one-line inline code spans), so a job or file name in code is not prose. `cost` refuses on every repository; `cost_private` refuses unless the repository's visibility reads public, since standard GitHub-hosted runner minutes are free there and larger runners are not (https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions).
